blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on the Fraser Avenue and Prairie Avenue streets of a small pocket, under the City's RS zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: minimum lot width is 15 metres in RS1, 12 metres in RS2, 30 metres in RS3 and 9.5 metres in RS4.

blocks.text: Birchland Manor Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The pocket is small enough that its school and its bus loop are its two landmarks: Birchland Elementary on Fraser Avenue inside it, and the 173/174 loop at Prairie Avenue and Coast Meridian Road on its west edge.
The secondary school named for this side of the city, Terry Fox Secondary, is in the neighbouring Riverwood pocket to the north, not inside Birchland Manor.
The board does not publish the sub-area's boundary roads, so two houses on the same street can fall on different sides of the board line.
Coast Meridian Road is the pocket's west edge and its route south to Lougheed Highway over the Coast Meridian Overpass, and Prairie Avenue is its east–west street.
The 173 and 174 bus loop at Prairie Avenue and Coast Meridian Road is the pocket's transit anchor.
